_comment: Per-model pricing, USD per MILLION tokens, from Anthropic's published list prices (claude.com/pricing). Keys are VERSION-SPECIFIC on purpose: within a major version the tier can change (Opus 4.5-4.8 are $5/$25, but Opus 4.0/4.1 are $15/$75), so a coarse 'claude-opus-4-x' would misprice. A session's model id is matched most-specific-first: exact id, then date-stripped version (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -> claude-haiku-4-5), then the coarse 'claude-<family>-<major>-x' fallback. Unpriced models are warned about and left at $0.00 — never priced as another model. Cache columns follow the standard multipliers (5m write = 1.25x input, 1h write = 2x input, read = 0.1x input). Verify against your own plan/tier (e.g. fast mode, batch, data-residency, and Sonnet's >200K-context tier differ).
